cards.speaker: Marcus Aurelius
cards.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events.
cards.translation: 당신은 바깥일이 아니라 자기 마음을 다스릴 힘이 있다.

cards.text: The next two sentences come from the same book.
cards.explanation:
Read them once before typing.
Second line of the note.

cards.speaker: Marcus Aurelius
cards.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
cards.translation: 좋은 사람이 어떠해야 하는지 따지느라 시간을 낭비하지 말라. 좋은 사람이 되어라.

cards.text:
I met a traveller from an antique land
Who said: Two vast and trunkless legs of stone

cards.speaker: Seneca
cards.text: It is not that we have a *short* time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
cards.translation: 우리에게 주어진 시간이 짧은 것이 아니라, 우리가 그 많은 시간을 낭비하는 것이다.
cards.explanation:
- **waste**: 낭비하다
- 출처: On the Shortness of Life (c. 49), https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/On_the_shortness_of_life
